test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 1over3 of a commodity is sold at the rate of 15% profit, 1over4 is sold at the rate of 20% profit and the rest is sold at the rate of 24% profit. If a total profit of Rs. 62 is earned, then find the cost price of the commodity.
solution:
**Given:**

1/3 of a commodity is sold at the rate of 15% profit.

1/4 of the commodity is sold at the rate of 20% profit.

The rest is sold at the rate of 24% profit.

Total profit earned = Rs. 62

**Formula Used:**

Weighted Average Profit = (Sum of (Profit rate × Fraction of commodity))/Total fractions

Total Profit = (Weighted Average Profit) × (Cost Price)

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the commodity be Rs. x.

Fraction of commodity sold at 15% profit = 1/3

Fraction of commodity sold at 20% profit = 1/4

Fraction of commodity sold at 24% profit = 1 - (1/3 + 1/4)

⇒ Fraction of commodity sold at 24% profit = 1 - (4/12 + 3/12)

⇒ Fraction of commodity sold at 24% profit = 1 - 7/12

⇒ Fraction of commodity sold at 24% profit = 5/12

Weighted Average Profit = (15% × 1/3) + (20% × 1/4) + (24% × 5/12)

⇒ Weighted Average Profit = (15/100 × 1/3) + (20/100 × 1/4) + (24/100 × 5/12)

⇒ Weighted Average Profit = 5/100 + 5/100 + 10/100

⇒ Weighted Average Profit = 20/100

⇒ Weighted Average Profit = 20%

Total Profit = 20% of Cost Price

⇒ 62 = 20/100 × x

⇒ 62 = 0.2 × x

⇒ x = 62 / 0.2

⇒ x = 310

**The cost price of the commodity is Rs. 310.**
